title: Retired Army vet arrested after alleged explicit messages to agent posing as teen
text:

46-year old retired Army veteran James Kenneth Rogers II was arrested for online solicitation of a a minor on Wednesday. SAN ANTONIO — A retired Army veteran was arrested for online solicitation of a minor after he allegedly sent sexually explicit messages and images to an undercover secret service agent posing as a teenage girl. 46-year old James Kenneth Rogers II had nothing to say as he was being hauled away in handcuffs on Wednesday.
An arrest warrant obtained by News 4/Fox SA alleges he was trying to get who he thought was a 16-year-old girl to meet him at his Northwest Bexar County home. Investigators say the conversation began early last month on the Whisper app then moved to text messages. Sheriff Javier Salazar said this arrest serves as a reminder for parents and guardians to keep an eye on your child's online activity. Two parasitic illnesses are spreading this summer.
Health officials say 10 cryptosporidium cases have been confirmed in Bexar County and urge residents to wash produce, avoid swallowing pool water and wash hands often.
